g.text: five irreducible primitives · four derived mechanisms composed from them
Four derived mechanisms — composed from the primitives, no new storage or observation of their own
Five primitives — irreducible: remove any one and whole classes of orchestration become impossible
Everything is a bead: tasks, mail, molecules, and convoys all live in the Beads Store. The Beads Store is the
universal persistence substrate, the Event Bus the universal observation substrate, and Config the universal
activation mechanism — the four mechanisms add nothing new, they compose these five.
